resources.name: UHN Comprehensive Ophthalmology Unit: existing-referral pathway
resources.location: Toronto, Ontario; confirm the specific clinic location with UHN
resources.purpose: Review an already-established referral with the clinic or referring care team. This is not a new referral or a screening recommendation.
resources.eligibility: Prototype selection requires an existing referral to this specific clinic confirmed by the synthetic scenario user. UHN must confirm acceptance and suitability.
resources.verification_note: Official UHN pages establish the unit and describe clinic visits. Existing-referral gating is a conservative prototype policy, not a claim that every patient qualifies.
limitations: The supplied Amina notes do not establish a UHN referral.
Clinic language, step-free access, appointment availability and costs were not verified; do not infer them.
In-person pathway excluded when the user cannot travel. Contacting a clinic does not mean care occurred.

resources.name: Ontario Health811: remote navigation
resources.location: Remote service for people in Ontario
resources.purpose: Ask for help finding local health services and clarifying next-step information by telephone. This does not perform a retinal examination.
resources.eligibility: Ontario navigation service; individual service access and interpretation arrangements should be confirmed directly.
resources.verification_note: Official Ontario/ Ontario Health indexed content confirms telephone navigation, English/French support and TTY access. Full-page retrieval was blocked; this review used the official indexed excerpts. Other specific language support is not assumed.
limitations: Navigation alternative only; not an equivalent substitute for an eye exam.
Wait times, individual eligibility and availability are not guaranteed.
Only English/French and TTY are encoded; unknown requested capabilities fail closed.
